order: Alternate engine order between pairs, finish each engine's complete candidate unload before launching the other.
preconditions: Verified unchanged baseline source and fixture hashes; exact native tool/build/source identity retained.
Same local endpoint, model digest, runtime, rubric, excerpt budget and server settings for both engines.
No resident model before each engine; leave unrelated model state unchanged and abort on conflicting use.
Pause agent builds and tests during model timing; user applications remain in normal use as explicitly requested.
Retain machine/RAM/power/load/pressure snapshots and model residency/context metadata.

comparison.absolute_model_quality: Preserve each report's original strict agreement, under-routing, tier coverage, timeout and stress acceptance; inherited failures remain visible.
comparison.language_port: Compare complete case/round outcomes under matched conditions; no unexplained native-only availability, protocol, cancellation or cleanup failure. Any policy/label differences stay unresolved until investigated; never relabel held-out fixtures or tune rubrics after seeing results.
comparison.variability: Five paired reports retain every cold/warm/stress sample and failure. Model variability or timing under normal background load cannot be projected away or called bit-identical deterministic classification.
comparison.cleanup: Unload only the explicitly tested candidate and verify no test-owned inference/transport/model worker remains.

separate_gates: Evaluator label quality is not downstream Claude task completion.
Normal-use 16GiB evidence does not approve controlled gateway performance targets.
A larger-than-24GiB Mac requires its own matched model/digest/condition reports.
Actual routing/profile/cancellation and real Claude task trials remain distinct from this evaluator benchmark.
No platform, archive, cutover or publication approval follows from completing this protocol.
